title: evidence/synonyms.json
description: Approved vocabulary translations. This file resolves the tension between using the employer's exact terminology and only claiming what the evidence supports. Only an entry here lets a JD term appear in output when the literal term is absent from the evidence. The model cannot add entries.

jd_term.description: The employer's wording, for example RESTful microservices.

evidence_term.description: The wording in the evidence that this JD term describes. Becomes part of the evidence corpus, so it is what makes the JD term permissible in output.

approved_by_yash.description: Present and true on every entry. The field exists so that an entry added by anything other than a deliberate hand edit is invalid rather than merely suspicious.
